title: Tiberius Claudius Donatus, Interpretationes Vergilianae — Interpretations of Vergil; Тиберий Клавдий Донат, «Толкования Вергилия». Proposed unit: Book 4
author: Tiberius Claudius Donatus
genre: Rhetorical commentary on the whole Aeneid
size: 12 books; Georgii 2 vols (~1,300 pp.); est. 350–400k words; ~35–40k words per book (estimates)
edition: Georgii, Teubner 1905–06 (public domain). New critical edition of Book 1: Pirovano, Pàtron 2025 (copyright)
ru_evidence: No Russian translation found; no ru.wikipedia article; not in the ancientrome.ru catalogue
en_evidence: en.wikipedia lists none; the publisher calls Pirovano's Italian Book 1 (2025) 'the first in a modern language'
other_translations: Italian, Book 1 only (L. Pirovano, Bologna: Pàtron 2025)
value: The only complete late-antique rhetorical reading of the Aeneid, presenting it as praise of Aeneas. Important for ancient criticism, rhetoric and Vergil reception (55 editions printed 1488–1599). Untranslated beyond Book 1 in any language
ai_feasibility: high — fluent paraphrastic prose with few rare terms; the risk is verbosity, so the commentary should summarise rather than annotate line by line
pilot_unit: Book 4 (Dido), est. 35–40k words; can be cross-read against Servius on Book 4 in English
